tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level snapshot: current day, headline metrics, exception count, sync health

tools.name: query_users
tools.description: Filter and group users by platform, country, or behavior. Returns users + per-user view_url

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get the user×day activity matrix the dashboard reads. Returns users with per-day activity plus view_url

tools.name: get_cohorts
tools.description: Get cohort retention data with smile flags and PMF verdict. Set payers to filter to people on the revenue join. Set split to compare up to 3 series by platform, country, or cluster.

payers.description: When true, keep only paying people

split.description: Compare retention curves by this field (max 3 series)

series.description: Comma-separated split values, max 3. A fourth series is refused.

tools.name: get_wbr
tools.description: Get Weekly Business Review with computed statuses

tools.name: get_sync_status
tools.description: Get connector freshness and sync state (last ingest, per-source last-sync, interval). Returns the same stamps as GET /api/v1/freshness and GET /api/v1/sync plus view_url

tools.name: connect_source
tools.description: Store per-source credentials encrypted at rest. Requires a write-scoped API key. Credentials are never returned. Returns connected + view_url.

source.description: Source id (ics, csv, or a connector slug)

credentials.description: Per-source credentials. Never echoed. csv stores kind + mapping.

tools.name: trigger_sync
tools.description: Trigger a connector sync for one source or all registered sources. Requires a write-scoped API key. Returns results, states, and view_url.

source.description: Connector source to sync. Omit or pass all to run every registered source.

tools.name: import_csv
tools.description: Import users or events from CSV. Requires a write-scoped API key. Optional preview returns column mapping without writing. Returns import counts and view_url.

kind.description: File kind. Detected from columns when omitted.

mapping.description: Column to field mapping. Reuses the csv source mapping when omitted.

preview.description: When true, return column mapping without writing.

tools.name: define_metric
tools.description: Create or update a WBR metric (name, section, input/output, unit, target, direction, source). Status is computed and cannot be written. Requires a write-scoped API key. Returns the metric plus view_url.

id.description: Metric id. Generated from the name when omitted.

section.description: Deck section: fin, acq, act, eng, or qua

target.description: Target value. Changing it does not rewrite history.

owner.description: Short owner mark on the card

source.description: event_count (optional event name + filters), revenue series, or manual/CSV

tools.name: disconnect_source
tools.description: Disconnect a source: delete stored credentials and sync state. Synced data stays, still tagged with this source. Requires a write-scoped API key. Returns disconnected + view_url.

source.description: Source id (ics, csv, or a connector slug)

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Pin a sticker or note to a person, date, metric, or cohort. Requires a write-scoped API key. Returns the annotation plus view_url.

targetType.description: person, date, metric, or cohort. user is accepted and stored as person.

targetId.description: Person id, YYYY-MM-DD, metric id, or cohort key the pin attaches to

tools.name: queue_outreach
tools.description: Queue a persisted outreach draft (waiting). Write scope can queue; it cannot approve.

tools.name: approve_outreach
tools.description: Approve a persisted outreach draft. Browser session or admin key only — a write key cannot approve.

tools.name: send_outreach
tools.description: Deliver an approved outreach draft. Unapproved drafts are refused.
